summary: Steep arterial kerb with apartments 11-13 m away and no-parking signs.

best_section.where: Whitmore Street west kerb, north of the Westerham Street junction

drivers.seclusion: Apartment blocks 12-13 m behind the kerb; homes all round.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerbside lane only; cars and a bus use the kerb.
drivers.traffic: Busy through road with a bus route.
drivers.convention: Some cars park on the east side; west side has signed restrictions.

sun_shade: Mixed tree cover on the west side; open to the east.
